title: Malmgren at the IDA, interviewed by the host

tellings.quote: you know, just sticking with Walker for a second, Walker was chairman of the Institute for Defense Analysis, the IDA, and Malmrren was a part of the IDA early on as well, and I had the privilege of interviewing Malgrren.

plain: Michels says that a man named Eric A. Walker chaired the Institute for Defense Analyses, known as the IDA, and that Harold Malmgren, a former presidential adviser, was part of the IDA early on. Michels tells this himself, adding that he had the privilege of interviewing Malmgren in person. He raises it to tie Malmgren to the same circle of people who, he suggests, sat close to the secrets.
